main.description: Bridge primitive: karute (etzhayyim) → iryo.etzhayyim.com (vendor). The patient must have previously issued a consent capability with purpose='insurance-billing' naming did:web:iryo.etzhayyim.com as grantee. This procedure forwards the encounter + service-request AT URIs and the capability URI to iryo; iryo verifies the capability signature and that purpose='insurance-billing', then claims insurance through Stripe/RisingWave (vendor side). Returns iryo's claim reference if accepted, error otherwise. Per ADR-2605231400 §'iryo bridge'.
